data.name: A Unified Algorithm Framework for Unsupervised Discovery of Skills based on Determinantal Point Process

data.description: A Unified Algorithm Framework for Unsupervised Discovery of Skills based on Determinantal Point Process discusses Soft Actor-Critic (SAC).
A Unified Algorithm Framework for Unsupervised Discovery of Skills based on Determinantal Point Process uses Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO).
A Unified Algorithm Framework for Unsupervised Discovery of Skills based on Determinantal Point Process discusses Task Planning.
